title: Inverse images of constructible sets under maps pulling back retrocompact opens
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces such that for every open subset $V\subseteq Y$ which is retrocompact in $Y$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] the inverse image $f^{-1}(V)$ is retrocompact in $X$. Then for every constructible subset $C\subseteq Y$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] the inverse image $f^{-1}(C)$ is a constructible subset of $X$ (Stacks Topology, Lemma 005I).

mathlib_searches.query: preimage of a constructible set under a continuous map pulling back retrocompact open sets to retrocompact sets is constructible
If f : X → Y is continuous and preimages of open retrocompact subsets are retrocompact, then preimages of constructible subsets are constructible
